game_concept: A tower defense set in Mystic Forest – Berry Thicket, a berry thicket: the beast tamer must handle bramble beasts while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Filter Harvest: Combine for and if to harvest only healing herbs that meet a rule.
theme: Mystic Forest – Berry Thicket: a berry thicket
core_gameplay_loop: In Berry Thicket, repeat each round: Combine for and if to harvest only healing herbs that meet a rule. Each round, bramble beasts strike the heartwood tree, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the harvest value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the heartwood tree from bramble beasts in Berry Thicket: keep the harvest meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 59-second timer ends.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: harvest drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 59-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 5 (applied tier): Filter Harvest
assets_style: lush pixel-art forest: dense green canopy, a glowing blue ancient tree, winding streams and dirt paths; flat Kenney-style sprites; airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Filter Harvest' (Week 5 slot 10), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Berry Thicket'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mystic Forest
region.mood: airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how harvest changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against bramble beasts in Berry Thicket.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 59 seconds while harvest > 0.
